content.title: Nike, Lululemon, and More Retail Stocks Rise on Vietnam Trade Deal
content.summary: Retail stocks got a lift Wednesday from the new trade deal with Vietnam.  The biggest movers were apparel and furniture sellers that manufacture their goods in Vietnam, such as On Holding, Nike, Wayfair, Williams-Sonoma, and The Lovesac Co.  Trump’s tariffs on goods from Vietnam were among the highest announced on his “Liberation Day” in April, but Wall Street expected rates would come down.
